sloka: सो ऽहं द्वितीयं काकुत्स्थ न वक्ष्यामि तवोत्तरम् ।मा द्वितीयेन दण्डो वै निपतेन्मयि मानद ।। ७.६३.७ ॥
transliteration: so 'haṁ dvitīyaṁ kākutstha na vakṣyāmi tavottaram ।mā dvitīyena daṇḍo vai nipatenmayi mānada ।। 7.63.7 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, O scion of Kakutstha, I will not speak a second reply to you, lest a second punishment indeed fall upon me, O giver of honor.
